title: 7 things that make long distance easier

slides.title: 7 things that make *long distance* easier
slides.sub: From couples who survived the airport goodbyes.

slides.title: Always have a *countdown.*
slides.body: A date on the calendar turns “someday” into *23 days.*

slides.title: Overlap your *routines.*
slides.body: Same coffee time. Same show. Same bedtime call.

slides.title: Send small things, *often.*
slides.body: A photo of your lunch beats a two-hour call *once a week.*

slides.title: Plan dates, not just *calls.*
slides.body: Cook the same recipe. Watch a movie in sync. Play a game together.

slides.title: Talk about the *hard days* too.
slides.body: Distance gets heavier when you pretend it’s fine.

slides.title: Keep your own life *full.*
slides.body: Friends, hobbies, plans. You’ll have more to share when you talk.

slides.title: Make an *“after”* list.
slides.body: Everything you’ll do when you’re finally in the same city.

slides.title: Save this *for the hard weeks.*
slides.sub: Then send it to the person you’re counting days for.
